$comment: Shipped defaults. User overrides live in <state>/config.json and win over these. The i8x default is the on-machine benchmark verdict for Apple M5 (see docs/BENCHMARK.md); `local-photo benchmark --suite variants --apply <id>` re-decides it for other hardware.
$comment_upscale: Lanczos 1.5x is the default delivery path: it is a pure resample, so it invents nothing and cannot invent artefacts (docs/BENCHMARK.md#upscaling--lanczos-vs-real-esrgan measured it at ~0.4 s and indistinguishable from the source on elderly skin). The unscaled render is always kept next to the delivered file as <name>.raw.<ext>. Generative upscalers stay opt-in. Turn the pass off with --upscale off.
